thread.title: FXTM adds NYSE and NASDAQ stocks to MT5 Pro Accounts, including Apple, Amazon, Facebook and more

author: Valentina Kirilova
title: FXTM adds NYSE and NASDAQ stocks to MT5 Pro Accounts, including Apple, Amazon, Facebook and more
text:
21,849 Posts 4,543 Comments Home Forex Brokers FXTM adds NYSE and NASDAQ stocks to MT5 Pro Accounts, including Apple, Amazon, Facebook and more FXTM adds NYSE and NASDAQ stocks to MT5 Pro Accounts, including Apple, Amazon, Facebook and more
CySEC, Belize and South Africa licensed Retail FX broker Forextime, which also goes by the shortened moniker FXTM, has announced that it has added stocks from the NYSE and NASDAQ exchanges to the MT5 Pro Accounts.
FXTM has launched the Pro Accounts back in April, providing now MetaTrader 5 users with the ability to directly own and trade stocks from NYSE and NASDAQ exchanges.
Investors are now able to own high-value stocks, including Apple Inc. (AAPL), Alibaba Group (BABA), Alphabet Inc. (GOOGL), Amazon Inc. (AMZN), Berkshire Hathaway (BRK.B), ExxonMobil Corporation (XOM), Facebook Inc. (FB), Microsoft Corporation (MSFT), Johnson& Johnson (JNJ) and JP Morgan Chase (JPM). Nandik Barbhaiya, FXTM
Nandik Barbhaiya, Global Head of Marketing at FXTM, commented on the new product:
We are devoted to our clients and constantly strive to offer innovative and tailored investment solutions. The new stock trading possibility offered via MetaTrader 5 is the way to meet individual investor needs. Thanks to direct liquidity pricing from the NASDAQ and the NYSE exchanges, we are very excited to offer this new option to our traders. The company’s clients will now be able to diversify their portfolios through direct ownership of shares from some of the biggest global conglomerates.
